presets.source:
; AIL v0.2 Discovery Example: Signed `i64` Refinements + Dependent Algebraic `struct`
; `ask` carries a dependent refinement `u64[bid..1000000000]` referencing `bid` inside `Quote`!

(struct Quote
  ((bid u64[0..1000000000])
   (ask u64[bid..1000000000])
   (pnl_adj i64[-50000..50000])))

(spec exact_spread ((bid int) (ask int))
  (- ask bid))

(spec exact_net_mid ((bid int) (ask int) (adj int))
  (+ (+ bid (/ (- ask bid) 2)) adj))

(spec exact_scaled_pnl ((pnl int))
  (trunc_div pnl 10))

(fn build_quote ((bid u64[0..999990000]) (spread u64[0..10000]) (pnl_adj i64[-50000..50000]))
  Quote
  (make Quote bid (+ bid spread) pnl_adj))

; Zero runtime underflow branches needed: Z3 proves `ask >= bid` directly from `Quote`'s dependent type!
(fn quote_spread ((q Quote))
  (out u64[0..1000000000] (== out (exact_spread (field q bid) (field q ask))))
  (- (field q ask) (field q bid)))

(fn quote_net_mid ((q Quote))
  (out i64[-50000..1000050000] (== out (exact_net_mid (field q bid) (field q ask) (field q pnl_adj))))
  (+ (to_i64 (+ (field q bid) (/ (- (field q ask) (field q bid)) 2))) (field q pnl_adj)))

(fn scale_signed_pnl ((pnl i64[-1000000..1000000]))
  (out i64[-100000..100000] (== out (exact_scaled_pnl pnl)))
  (/ pnl 10))

  (Partial (filled u64[1..100000]) (rem u64[1..100000]) (price u64[1..1000000]))
  (Rejected (err_code i64[-1000..-1]))
  (Cancelled))

(spec exact_notional ((o SettleOutcome))
  (match o
    ((Filled q p) (* q p))
    ((Partial q rem p) (* q p))
    ((Rejected c) 0)
    ((Cancelled) 0)))

(spec exact_audit_score ((o SettleOutcome))
  (match o
    ((Filled q p) (to_i64 q))
    ((Partial q rem p) (to_i64 q))
    ((Rejected c) c)

(spec exact_is_rejected ((o SettleOutcome))
  (if (is_variant o Rejected) 1 0))

  SettleOutcome
  (variant SettleOutcome Filled q p))

(fn make_rejected ((code i64[-1000..-1]))

  (variant SettleOutcome Rejected code))

(fn outcome_notional ((o SettleOutcome))
  (out u64[0..100000000000] (== out (exact_notional o)))
  (match o
    ((Filled q p) (* q p))
    ((Partial q rem p) (* q p))
    ((Rejected c) 0)
    ((Cancelled) 0)))

  (match o
    ((Filled q p) (to_i64 q))
    ((Partial q rem p) (to_i64 q))
    ((Rejected c) c)
    ((Cancelled) 0)))

(fn is_rejected_outcome ((o SettleOutcome))
  (out u64[0..1] (== out (exact_is_rejected o)))
  (if (is_variant o Rejected) 1 0))

; AIL v1.0 Example: Verified DeFi Yield & Liquidation Waterfall
; Demonstrates cross-module `(import ...)` composition of `stdlib/finance` and `stdlib/math` with `(const ...)`.

(import "stdlib/finance")
(import "stdlib/math")

(const PROTOCOL_MAX_FEE_BPS u64 500)
(const RESERVE_RATIO_BPS u64 2000)
(const SHARE_ROUNDING_MIN u64 1)

(spec spec_tranche_junior_payout ((gross int) (senior_cap int) (fee_bps int) (reserve_bps int))
  (let ((net (- gross (/ (* gross fee_bps) 10000)))
        (fee (- gross net))
        (reserve (/ (* fee reserve_bps) 10000))
        (distributable (+ net (- fee reserve)))
        (senior (min distributable senior_cap)))
    (max (- distributable senior) 0)))

(fn waterfall_junior_payout
  ((gross u64[0..100000000000000])
   (senior_cap u64[0..100000000000000])
   (fee_bps u64[0..PROTOCOL_MAX_FEE_BPS])
   (reserve_bps u64[0..RESERVE_RATIO_BPS]))
  (out u64[0..100000000000000] (== out (spec_tranche_junior_payout gross senior_cap fee_bps reserve_bps)))
  (let ((net (call net_after_bps_fee gross fee_bps))
        (fee (call abs_diff_u64 gross net))
        (reserve (call mul_bps_floor fee reserve_bps))
        (after_res (call sat_sub_u64 fee reserve))
        (distributable (call sat_add_u64 net after_res))
        (senior (call clamp_u64 distributable 0 senior_cap)))
    (call sat_sub_u64 distributable senior)))

(fn share_price_ceil_per_unit
  ((total_assets u64[0..100000000000000])
   (total_shares u64[SHARE_ROUNDING_MIN..100000000000000]))
  (out u64[0..100000000000000]
    (== out (if (== total_assets 0) 0 (+ 1 (/ (- total_assets 1) total_shares)))))
  (call div_ceil_u64 total_assets total_shares))

(spec quote_spread_bps_spec ((q Quote2Way))
  (/ (* (- (field q ask) (field q bid)) 10000) (field q bid)))

(fn pool_quote_health_check
  ((q Quote2Way)
   (notional u64[0..100000000000000])
   (rebate_bps u64[0..PROTOCOL_MAX_FEE_BPS])
   (max_rebate u64[0..100000000000000]))
  (out u64[0..MAX]
    (== out (+ (quote_spread_bps_spec q) (min (/ (* notional rebate_bps) 10000) max_rebate))))
  (let ((spread (call quote_spread_bps q))
        (rebate (call maker_rebate_capped notional rebate_bps max_rebate)))
    (+ spread rebate)))

; AIL v1.0 Example: Zero-CVE Binary Wire Frame Parser
; Imports verified big-endian & magic-byte helpers from `stdlib/parse`.

(import "stdlib/parse")

(const AIL_HDR_BYTES u64 8)
(const AIL_FRAME_V1 u64 1)
(const AIL_MIN_VALID_FRAME u64 12)

(enum FrameResult
  (Valid (version u64[1..255]) (flags u64[0..255]) (payload_len u64[0..65535]) (seq u64[0..4294967295]))
  (BadMagic)
  (UnsupportedVersion (found u64[0..255]))
  (Truncated (actual u64[0..MAX]) (needed u64[1..MAX])))

(spec exact_frame_seq ((r FrameResult))
  (match r
    ((Valid ver fl plen s) s)
    ((BadMagic) 0)
    ((UnsupportedVersion v) 0)
    ((Truncated act need) 0)))

(fn parse_frame ((n u64[0..MAX]) (buf (bytes n)))
  FrameResult
  (if (< n AIL_HDR_BYTES)
    (variant FrameResult Truncated n AIL_HDR_BYTES)
    (if (== (call has_ail_magic n buf) 0)
      (variant FrameResult BadMagic)
      (let ((ver (call frame_version_byte n buf)))
        (if (!= ver AIL_FRAME_V1)
          (variant FrameResult UnsupportedVersion ver)
          (let ((flags (byte_at buf 5))
                (plen (call frame_payload_len_u16 n buf))
                (needed (+ AIL_HDR_BYTES plen)))
            (if (< n needed)
              (variant FrameResult Truncated n needed)
              (if (< plen 4)
                (variant FrameResult Truncated n AIL_MIN_VALID_FRAME)
                (let ((seq (read_u32_be buf 8)))
                  (variant FrameResult Valid ver flags plen seq))))))))))

(fn read_frame_u64_payload ((n u64[16..MAX]) (buf (bytes n)))
  (out u64[0..MAX] (== out (read_u64_be buf 8)))
  (read_u64_be buf 8))

(fn frame_result_seq ((r FrameResult))
  (out u64[0..4294967295] (== out (exact_frame_seq r)))
  (match r
    ((Valid ver fl plen s) s)
    ((BadMagic) 0)
    ((UnsupportedVersion v) 0)
    ((Truncated act need) 0)))
